content:
FAQ Content context:
- FAQ content is shown in chat and Backoffice modals.
- Web-side FAQ loading is in AIChatApp.Web/Services/FaqContentService.cs.
- API-side topic loading uses AssistantContentService.LoadTopicsAsync and fallback Faq.json.
- FAQ topics are broader than Quick Answers. They help provide project context but should not override exact quick answers.
- FAQ UI should remain searchable, paginated, responsive, and readable on desktop, tablet, and mobile.
